build_fuse_fx: build a torch.nn.Module and call fuse_fx to fuse conv+bn+relu patterns before quantization
test_prepare_fx: test prepare_fx to insert observers into a model for post-training quantization with a qconfig_mapping
refactor_prepare_qat_fx: refactor a model with prepare_qat_fx to insert fake quant modules for quantization aware training
run_convert_fx: run convert_fx to transform a calibrated GraphModule into a backend-optimized quantized model
review_convert_to_reference_fx: review convert_to_reference_fx to produce a reference quantized model for further hardware lowering
